invariants.rationale: The context is typically required for engine operations and should not be null.
The instantTime parameter usually denotes a timestamp or commit instant, expected to be non-null and non-empty.
The partitions list is required as input; should not be null to avoid NullPointerException in processing.
List size is never negative; ensures proper list state if not null.
If instantTime is not null, it is expected to have at least one non-whitespace character.
